# Third-party component notices

This directory contains small, project-local adaptations rather than a copied full component library.

- `curvable/SweepHeadline.tsx` is adapted from Curvable Motion's `TextHover` component, MIT licensed: https://github.com/Curvable/motion
- `remotion-scenes/AnimatedLineTrace.tsx` is adapted from `DataLineChart` in Remotion Scenes, MIT licensed: https://github.com/lifeprompt-team/remotion-scenes

The adaptations use the project's own colors, props and layout; retain this notice when redistributing the source.
